name: @statens-pensjonskasse/skatt-inntekt-api
description: Npm package holds OpenAPI specification for Skatteetatens Inntekt API
_README_: BEWARE: THIS IS NOT A VANILLA NODE PROJECT, LET ME COUNT THE WAYS:
version is managed by update-spec script to align with API version
scripts are for development use, no dependencies are allowed
files are downloaded and NEVER EDITED
LICENSE must not be attached, as the downloaded files are not ours to license

scripts.prepublishOnly: if [ -f LICENSE ]; then mv LICENSE _LICENSE_BAK; fi
scripts.lint: redocly lint skatt-inntekt-api.yaml && redocly lint skatt-inntekt-api.json
